title: Sun Glare and Visor Visibility
summary: This topic centers on bright sunlight making controls harder to see and on limited sun-visor coverage, with many fragments too brief to classify confidently.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe controls becoming unreadable in bright daylight and a sun visor that does not extend enough to block sunlight from the side window.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention brightness, sun shining on controls, weak visor-mirror lighting, and visibility issues in strong sun, but several are too brief or unclear to confirm the exact complaint.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too brief or context-limited to support a more specific sentiment classification.
The cluster combines related but distinct issues, including sunlight glare on controls, visor extension, and weak visor-mirror lighting.
